title: two-stage textbook example
nl_spec: Design an operational amplifier (differential input, single-ended output) in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 10 pF; a 10 uA reference current is available at ibias. Requirements: DC gain of at least 70 dB; unity-gain bandwidth of at least 10 MHz; phase margin of at least 60 degrees; slew rate of at least 10 MV/s; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 1 mW; output swing of at least 1.2 V.

title: micropower sensor OTA
nl_spec: Design an operational amplifier (differential input, single-ended output) in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 5 pF; a 1 uA reference current is available at ibias. Requirements: DC gain of at least 60 dB; unity-gain bandwidth of at least 1 MHz; phase margin of at least 60 degrees; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 20 uW.

title: high-speed OTA
nl_spec: Design an operational amplifier (differential input, single-ended output) in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 1 pF; a 10 uA reference current is available at ibias. Requirements: DC gain of at least 45 dB; unity-gain bandwidth of at least 150 MHz; phase margin of at least 55 degrees; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 2 mW.

title: high-gain op-amp
nl_spec: Design an operational amplifier (differential input, single-ended output) in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 5 pF; a 10 uA reference current is available at ibias. Requirements: DC gain of at least 90 dB; unity-gain bandwidth of at least 5 MHz; phase margin of at least 60 degrees; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 500 uW; output swing of at least 1 V.

title: large-load buffer amplifier
nl_spec: Design an operational amplifier (differential input, single-ended output) in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 100 pF; a 10 uA reference current is available at ibias. Requirements: DC gain of at least 60 dB; unity-gain bandwidth of at least 2 MHz; phase margin of at least 55 degrees; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 500 uW.

title: low-noise op-amp
nl_spec: Design an operational amplifier (differential input, single-ended output) in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 2 pF; a 10 uA reference current is available at ibias. Requirements: input-referred noise density at 1 kHz of at most 50 nV/sqrt(Hz); DC gain of at least 60 dB; unity-gain bandwidth of at least 10 MHz; phase margin of at least 55 degrees; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 1 mW.

title: robust general-purpose op-amp
nl_spec: Design an operational amplifier (differential input, single-ended output) in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 2 pF; a 10 uA reference current is available at ibias. Requirements: DC gain of at least 60 dB; unity-gain bandwidth of at least 10 MHz; phase margin of at least 50 degrees; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 600 uW. All requirements must hold across process corners (tt, ff, ss, sf, fs), temperatures -40/27/125 C and supply 1.62-1.98 V.

title: on-chip LDO 1.2 V / 10 mA
nl_spec: Design a low-dropout linear regulator in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 1 nF; input 1.8 V, reference 0.6 V, target output 1.2 V, load current 100 uA to 10 mA, 10 uA bias current at ibias. Requirements: output-voltage error relative to the target of at most 2 %; load regulation of at most 2 V/A (= mV/mA); line regulation of at most 10 mV/V; PSRR at 1 kHz of at least 40 dB; quiescent current (at minimum load, including IREF) of at most 100 uA; load-step undershoot of at most 100 mV; residual ringing (peak-to-peak) 7-10 us after each load step of at most 10 mV.

title: robust LDO 1.2 V / 5 mA
nl_spec: Design a low-dropout linear regulator in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 1 nF; input 1.8 V, reference 0.6 V, target output 1.2 V, load current 50 uA to 5 mA, 10 uA bias current at ibias. Requirements: output-voltage error relative to the target of at most 3 %; load regulation of at most 5 V/A (= mV/mA); residual ringing (peak-to-peak) 7-10 us after each load step of at most 10 mV; quiescent current (at minimum load, including IREF) of at most 200 uA. All requirements must hold across process corners (tt, ff, ss, sf, fs), temperatures -40/27/125 C and supply 1.62-1.98 V.

title: bandgap reference
nl_spec: Design a self-biased voltage reference in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Requirements: reference voltage at 27 C between 1.1 V and 1.3 V; temperature coefficient over -40..125 C of at most 30 ppm/C; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 100 uW; line regulation of at most 10 mV/V; reliable start-up (1 = yes) of at least 1.

title: robust bandgap reference
nl_spec: Design a self-biased voltage reference in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Requirements: reference voltage at 27 C between 1 V and 1.35 V; temperature coefficient over -40..125 C of at most 60 ppm/C; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 200 uW; reliable start-up (1 = yes) of at least 1. All requirements must hold across process corners (tt, ff, ss, sf, fs), temperatures -40/27/125 C and supply 1.62-1.98 V.

title: fast continuous-time comparator
nl_spec: Design a continuous-time voltage comparator in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 50 fF; a 10 uA reference current is available at ibias; input common mode 0.9 V, overdrive +-10 mV. Requirements: propagation delay of at most 5 ns; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 200 uW; correct output polarity (1 = yes) of at least 1; output high level of at least 1.62 V; output low level of at most 0.18 V.

title: 1 GHz dynamic comparator
nl_spec: Design a clocked (dynamic) comparator in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 10 fF; clock 1 GHz, input difference +-1 mV around 0.9 V. Requirements: correct decisions (1 = yes) of at least 1; clock-to-output delay of at most 150 ps; energy per comparison of at most 100 fJ.

title: GHz ring VCO
nl_spec: Design a voltage-controlled oscillator in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 10 fF; control voltage range 0.6-1.4 V. Requirements: oscillation frequency at the mid control voltage of at least 1 GHz; tuning ratio fmax/fmin of at least 3; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 500 uW; output swing of at least 1.4 V.

title: low-power 100 MHz VCO
nl_spec: Design a voltage-controlled oscillator in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 10 fF; control voltage range 0.6-1.4 V. Requirements: oscillation frequency at the mid control voltage between 90 MHz and 110 MHz; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 20 uW; output swing of at least 1.2 V.

title: 2nd-order Butterworth low-pass 1 MHz
nl_spec: Design an active filter in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 1 pF; a 10 uA reference current is available at ibias; lowpass response, stop frequency = 10 x fc. Requirements: -3 dB cutoff frequency between 950 kHz and 1.05 MHz; passband peaking of at most 0.5 dB; attenuation at the stop frequency of at least 35 dB; DC gain between -1 dB and 1 dB; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 300 uW.

title: 3rd-order low-pass 100 kHz
nl_spec: Design an active filter in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 1 pF; a 10 uA reference current is available at ibias; lowpass response, stop frequency = 10 x fc. Requirements: -3 dB cutoff frequency between 95 kHz and 105 kHz; attenuation at the stop frequency of at least 55 dB; DC gain between -1 dB and 1 dB; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 300 uW.

title: band-pass 1 MHz, Q 2-3
nl_spec: Design an active filter in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 1 pF; a 10 uA reference current is available at ibias; bandpass response. Requirements: centre frequency between 950 kHz and 1.05 MHz; quality factor between 2 and 3; DC gain of at least 0 dB; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 500 uW.

title: 300 MHz optical TIA
nl_spec: Design a transimpedance amplifier for a photodiode front-end in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 200 fF; a 10 uA reference current is available at ibias; photodiode capacitance 300 fF. Requirements: transimpedance gain of at least 74 dB-ohm; -3 dB bandwidth of at least 300 MHz; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 2 mW; output DC level between 0.3 V and 1.5 V.

title: 1:4 wide-swing mirror
nl_spec: Design a current mirror in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: input current 10 uA, target output current 40 uA (ratio 4) at 0.9 V. Requirements: output-current error relative to the target of at most 2 %; output resistance at the nominal output voltage of at least 5 Mohm; output compliance voltage (minimum output voltage keeping >=95% of the current) of at most 0.4 V.

title: high-impedance 50 uA sink
nl_spec: Design a current mirror in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: input current 50 uA, target output current 50 uA (ratio 1) at 0.9 V. Requirements: output-current error relative to the target of at most 2 %; output resistance at the nominal output voltage of at least 20 Mohm.

title: wideband CS gain stage
nl_spec: Design a single-ended voltage amplifier in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 500 fF; a 10 uA reference current is available at ibias; input DC bias 0.75 V. Requirements: DC gain of at least 26 dB; -3 dB bandwidth of at least 50 MHz; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 300 uW; output DC level between 0.6 V and 1.2 V.

title: inverting amplifier x10
nl_spec: Design an op-amp-based analog computing circuit in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 1 pF; a 10 uA reference current is available at ibias; function: inverting amplifier of vin1 (vin2 unused). Requirements: gain from vin1 between -10.1 V/V and -9.9 V/V; closed-loop -3 dB bandwidth of at least 2 MHz; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 500 uW; output DC offset from 0.9 V between -0.02 V and 0.02 V.

title: 10 kHz integrator
nl_spec: Design an op-amp-based analog computing circuit in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 1 pF; a 10 uA reference current is available at ibias; function: inverting integrator of vin1 (vin2 unused). Requirements: integrator unity-gain frequency between 9.5 kHz and 10.5 kHz; magnitude slope below f_unity between -21 dB/decade and -19 dB/decade; output DC offset from 0.9 V between -0.05 V and 0.05 V; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 300 uW.

title: centred Schmitt trigger
nl_spec: Design a Schmitt trigger in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Requirements: upper switching threshold between 1 V and 1.2 V; lower switching threshold between 0.6 V and 0.8 V; output high level of at least 1.7 V; output low level of at most 0.1 V.
